name: GPT-2 small
summary: OpenAI's released baseline uses a 12-block decoder-only Transformer with learned token and position embeddings.

sources.label: Language Models are Unsupervised Multitask Learners

stages.title: Byte-pair token IDs
stages.summary: Byte-level BPE produces IDs for a 50,257-entry vocabulary.

stages.title: Token and position embeddings
stages.summary: Learned token and position tables produce a width-768 residual stream.

stages.title: Masked self-attention
stages.summary: Each of 12 repeated blocks uses 12 causal attention heads and a residual update.

stages.title: Position-wise MLP
stages.summary: Each repeated block applies GELU between width-768 and width-3,072 projections.

stages.title: Final norm and tied output
stages.summary: Final layer normalisation feeds logits through the transposed token-embedding table.
